message.reasoning_content:
The t8 probe: poisoned V slots at expired positions AND unreferenced pages — but validate_inputs only checks live positions reachable... wait, it passed validation. NaN count 512 out of 1*4*2*64=512 — all NaN! Whole output NaN. But wait: could NaN come from the poisoned unreferenced pages? Kernel only loads logical < max_prefix, so unreferenced pages never loaded. So NaN must come from expired positions 64..91 loaded in tile 1. That's the defect. Confirmed.

One caveat: out_pois fully NaN (512 = all elements). Could a separate check isolate? The whole-batch output all NaN even for rows whose window doesn't include poisoned slots — consistent with 0*NaN poisoning every row's tile. Good enough. Finalize c1 as confirmed, then run c2 sweep.
